📖 Reading & Listening

Reading Go Green

0 / 0

After many years since the Industrial Revolution and the misuse of technology, the large-scale production of machines and automobiles has had harmful effects on the environment. These technologies have mainly caused damage in two ways: through air and water pollution, and through the overuse of natural resources. For this reason, environmental concerns have become a major issue across all industries.

Why green?

Green is more than just a color. "Going green" means making changes in the way individuals, organizations, and societies live and work so that their actions are more environmentally friendly. Today, "Go Green" has become a widely used slogan in industry. Green manufacturing refers to producing goods in ways that do not harm the environment and that help preserve natural resources for future generations.

The concept of "green manufacturing" can be understood in two ways. First, it means producing environmentally friendly products by using renewable energy and clean technologies. Second, it refers to making the manufacturing process itself greener — reducing pollution and waste by cutting down on resource use, recycling, and reusing materials. This approach helps slow the depletion of natural resources and reduces the amount of waste going into landfills. Both manufacturers and consumers play a role in the fight against climate change, and building a sustainable future is essential.

While the process may be costly and require strong commitment, many companies have already taken the initiative to adopt green practices.

One negative outcome of the Industrial Revolution is global warming, which has become a major topic of discussion in international forums and on social media. This is why many manufacturers are now working to transform their factories into eco-friendly production plants.

Listening One Bag at a Time

0 / 0

"Good evening everyone. My name is Ahmed and I'm honored to be here today. Last year I wanted to do something that would help both our community and our environment. I noticed that many shops used a lot of plastic bags which cost money and were often thrown away after just one use.

So I started a campaign called One Bag at a Time. My idea was simple. Encourage shops to offer reusable cloth bags instead of plastic ones. I visited shop owners, explained how this would save them money, reduce waste, and keep our neighborhood cleaner.

To make it fun, I organized a bag swap day where customers could exchange their old plastic bags for free cloth bags. Families loved the idea and soon more shops joined in. Today, more than half of the shops in our area have reduced their plastic use. We've saved hundreds of bags, cut down costs, and inspired others to make small changes that protect our planet."

remember + V-ing ← يقوم بعمل شىء ثم يتذكر أنه فعله
  • He remembered watching this film. (تذكر أنه شاهد هذا الفيلم)
forgetينسى
forget to + inf. ← ينسى أن يفعل شيئًا (لم يفعله)
  • Nadia forgot to close the gate.
forget + V-ing ← يفعل شيئًا ثم ينسى أنه فعله
  • Nadia forgot reading the novel.
regretيأسف
regret to + inf. ← يشعر بالأسف لأن يقول أو يخبر شخصًا شيئًا ما
  • I regret to say that my son is a loser.
regret + V-ing ← يشعر بالندم على شىء حدث
  • He regretted watching this play. It was boring.
tryيحاول / يجرب
try to + inf. ← يحاول عمل شىء (وغالبًا لا ينجح)
  • The student tried to escape, but the headmaster caught him.
try + V-ing ← يقوم بعمل شىء ليرى نتيجته / يجرب عمل شىء
  • Try wearing this dress.
  • Try taking an aspirin.
stopيتوقف
stop to + inf. ← يتوقف لكى يفعل شيئًا
  • He stopped to smoke. (توقف لكى يدخن)
stop + V-ing ← يتوقف عن عمل شىء
  • He stopped smoking. (توقف عن التدخين)
go onيستمر
go on to + inf. ← ينتقل بعد ذلك إلى فعل آخر (يفعل شيئًا جديدًا)
  • He went on to talk about another topic.
go on + V-ing ← يستمر فى نفس الفعل
  • They went on working despite the rain.

تعبيرات تنتهى بـ to ويأتى بعدها v + ing

object toيعترض على
be accustomed toمعتاد على
due toبسبب
owing toبسبب
contribute toيساهم فى
be opposed toمعارض لـ
devote … toيخصص … لـ
take toيعتاد على
be used toمعتاد على
get used toيعتاد على
thanks toبفضل
look forward toيتطلع إلى
lead toيؤدى إلى
in addition toبالإضافة إلى
  • I object to smoking in this room.
  • She is accustomed to waking up early.

تعبيرات يأتى بعدها v + ing

be worthيستحق
it's a waste of moneyمضيعة للمال
it's a waste of timeمضيعة للوقت
feel likeيرغب / يريد
how about – what aboutماذا عن
don't mindلا يمانع
be busyمشغول
have difficulty (in)يجد صعوبة فى
it's no good = it's no useلا فائدة من
there is no point inلا فائدة من
can't standلا يحتمل
can't helpلا يستطيع منع نفسه من
  • She has difficulty walking.
  • It's a waste of time surfing the internet.
  • I feel like having a cold drink.

to + inf. بعد الصفات وأدوات الاستفهام

فى حالة وجود فعل بعد الصفات التالية نستخدم to + inf.
happy / sad / glad / pleased / lucky / relieved / amazed / difficult / easy …
  • It is difficult for her to get up early.
  • It was easy for Jana to study English.
وفى حالة وجود فعل بعد أدوات الاستفهام نستخدم to + inf.
how to  ·  what to  ·  where to  + inf.
  • I don't know how to go to the club.
  • He is in a tight corner; he doesn't know what to do.

Important Notes ملاحظات هامة

① like / would like / feel like
  • Seif likes to play (playing) football.
  • Seif would like to play football.
  • Seif feels like playing football.
② أفعال يأتى بعدها مفعول ثم to + inf. فى المعلوم، وفى حالة المبنى للمجهول تأتى to + inf. بعد الفعل مباشرة.
adviseينصح
allowيسمح
askيطلب
inviteيدعو
tellيخبر
chooseيختار
requireيتطلب
encourageيشجع
expectيتوقع
promiseيعد
helpيساعد
teachيعلّم
challengeيتحدى
wantيريد
orderيأمر
permitيسمح
persuadeيقنع
forceيجبر
commandيأمر
begيتوسل
instructيعطى توجيهًا
  • The teacher advised the students to revise their lessons. (active)
  • The students were advised to revise their lessons. (passive)

أفعال تتغير حسب وجود المفعول

الأفعال الآتية يأتى بعدها ing فى حالة عدم وجود مفعول، ويأتى بعدها to + inf. فى حالة وجود مفعول:
adviseينصحforbidيمنعpermitيسمح
allowيسمحrecommendيوصى بـencourageيشجع
  • I advise you to read this novel. (مع مفعول)
  • I advise reading this novel. (بدون مفعول)
  • He doesn't allow smoking.

أفعال الحواس hear · see · notice · watch

يُستخدم بعدها المصدر ليدل على أننا شاهدنا أو سمعنا الحدث بالكامل، ويأتى بعدها الفعل مضافًا له ing ليدل على أننا سمعنا أو شاهدنا جزءًا من الحدث.
hearيسمعnoticeيلاحظ
seeيرىwatchيشاهد
  • I heard Toka sing a song. = I heard the whole song.
  • I heard Toka singing a song. = I heard part of the song.

حالات أخرى للمصدر

① استخدام to + inf. بعد الترتيب أو التفضيل:
the first … / the second … / the last / the next
  • Ahmed was the first to get high marks.
  • Toka was the last to attend the meeting.
② يُستخدم المصدر بدون to بعد الأفعال الناقصة:
can / could / may / might / must / mustn't / needn't / shall / should / will / would
  • They must attend the conference.
  • She can run very quickly.
③ فعل help يأتى بعده المصدر مع to أو بدون to:
  • Toka helped Jana do her homework.
  • Toka helped Jana to do her homework.

الصيغة الإلزامية suggest · recommend · insist · vital · important · essential

لاحظ أن الكلمات suggest / recommend / advise / insist / vital / important / essential إذا جاء بعدها that وجملة، يأتى بعدهم inf. أو should + inf.
  • I recommended that Ali (should) visit Alex.
  • I suggest that Ali (should) visit Alex.
  • It is important that every child have the same opportunities.
  • It is essential that the data be accurate for the report to be useful.
  • It is vital that he understand the rules before participating in the competition.
  • It is important that she complete the assignment before the deadline.
  • It is essential that Ali follow the safety procedures to avoid any accidents.
وللحظ فى حالة النفى مع الكلمات السابقة لا نستخدم do / does / did ولكن ننفى بـ not توضع قبل الفعل الأساسى:
  • We recommend that he not leave school before eighteen.

impact, influence, affect, effect & effective

impact (v/n)تأثير / أثر / يؤثر فى▸ Pollution has a negative impact on human health.
influence (v/n)تأثير / نفوذ / يؤثر فى▸ Social media has an influence on young people.
affect (v)يؤثر فى / يترك أثرًا فى▸ Lack of sleep can affect your concentration.
effect (n)تأثير / أثر / نتيجة▸ Exercise has a positive effect on mental health.
effective (adj)فعّال / مؤثر / ناجح▸ The medicine proved effective in treating the disease.

assembly, meeting & gathering

assemblyاجتماع رسمى / مجلس / تجمّع منظم▸ The school assembly started at 8 a.m.
meetingمقابلة / اجتماع (رسمى أو غير رسمى)▸ We have a meeting to plan the new project.
gatheringتجمع (غالبًا اجتماعى)▸ We enjoyed a family gathering last night.

mission, task, duty, assignment & goal

missionمهمة / رسالة (مهمة لها هدف كبير)▸ The team's mission is to protect the environment.
taskمهمة صغيرة / واجب محدد▸ My task today is to finish this report.
dutyواجب / التزام (أخلاقى أو رسمى)▸ It is our duty to help the poor.
assignmentتكليف / واجب (أكاديمى أو إدارى)▸ The teacher gave us an assignment on pollution.
goal / aimهدف▸ Their goal is to reduce pollution.

include, contain, consist & exclude

includeيشمل / يتضمن▸ The price includes delivery costs and all additional taxes.
containيحتوى على / يضم بداخله▸ This bottle contains two litres of clean drinking water.
consist (of)يتكون / يتألف▸ Our team consists of experienced teachers and designers.
excludeيستبعد / يستثنى / يمنع▸ The stated price excludes delivery and installation costs.
📖 Reading & Listening — Part 2

Reading Helping our community

0 / 0

In a bright and busy classroom, the students were discussing ways to help their community and protect the environment. Their teacher suggested forming special teams, each with a unique mission. One of the most active groups was called "The Water Team".

The Water Team's mission was simple but important: to survey the school's water sources. This included taps in the bathrooms, sinks in the science lab, and the water fountains in the playground. Their first task was to check for any drips or leaks.

Even a small leak can waste many liters of water each day, so finding and fixing them would make a big difference.

The students also observed how water was used during the day. They noticed that some taps were left running while students washed their hands or filled bottles. They recorded these observations carefully in a notebook.

After two weeks of research, The Water Team presented their findings at the school assembly. They shared photos, charts, and ideas for saving water, such as turning off taps completely and using water bottles instead of paper cups.

Their work inspired other classes to start saving water, too. It proved that even small changes, when made by many people, can have a big impact on the community and the planet.

Listening Small Actions Can Make a Difference

0 / 0

Keeping our environment clean is one of the most important responsibilities for people today. Protecting nature means learning how to live without causing serious harm to the world around us. By practicing recycling, reducing waste, and reusing products, we can all play a part in building a healthier planet.

One of the best ways to help is to stop using much plastic. Carrying a reusable bag and bringing your own water bottle are simple actions that make a big difference. Another useful habit is turning off lights when leaving a room, and unplugging devices that are not in use.

Saving energy helps reduce pollution, and keeps resources from running out too quickly. In addition, we need to plant more trees, and to clean public spaces regularly. Planting trees gives us fresh air, and cleaning our streets and parks makes our communities safer and more beautiful.

We should also encourage people to walk or cycle, and avoid driving everywhere. By working together, and choosing to take small actions every day, we can create a cleaner, greener, and more sustainable future.

Formal Email Writing خطوات كتابة الإيميل الرسمى

1Definition — التعريف
  • A formal email is a message written in a polite and organized way, used for important matters such as applying for a job, making a request, or submitting a complaint.
البريد الإلكترونى الرسمى هو رسالة مكتوبة بطريقة مهذبة ومنظمة، نستخدمها فى الأمور المهمة مثل التقدم لوظيفة أو تقديم طلب أو شكوى.
2Formal Email Template — القالب
  • Subject: [Clear and Professional Subject]
  • Dear [Title + Last Name],
  • I am writing to [state your purpose clearly].
  • [Give details in full sentences. Be polite and professional.]
  • Thank you for your time and consideration.
  • Yours sincerely,
    [Your Full Name]
3Formal Email Essentials — الأساسيات
  • Greeting التحية — Dear Sir / Madam,  ·  Dear Mr. Ali,
  • Language اللغة — Polite, complete sentences, no slang
  • Purpose الغرض — Job application, complaint, official request
  • Closing الختام — Yours sincerely, / Kind regards,

All around the world, buildings are going green! What does it mean to go green or to make a green building? A green building is a structure designed to be environmentally responsible and resource-efficient throughout its entire life-cycle in a way that is kinder to the environment. This building uses energy, water and other resources that cause no pollution.

In the first step of making a green building, the architect must think about three main important features. These are: the use of water, energy, and materials. The architect plans how to use energy and space in a way that will not harm the environment.

There are many ways to save energy. Architects can design buildings to use natural light. Buildings can also be made with solar or wind power to get energy from the sun or the wind. To save water, low-flow fixtures, rainwater harvesting and grey water systems can be implemented. Moreover, green buildings can have areas on the roofs to collect rain water.

Bathrooms and kitchens can have sinks and toilets that conserve water. As for the material used in building, it is important to focus on sustainability, using rapid renewable resources and recycled content. This can reduce embodied carbon and protect the environment. It is thought that having green buildings is a must in the recent time.

1He refused to answer the question. الأقصر ٢٠٣٦ (avoided)
He avoided answering the question.
2Would you like to come to the party? بني سويف ٢٠٣٦ (coming)
Would you mind coming to the party? / How about coming to the party?
Answer the following questions (The Novel)
3Why is Santiago's fight with the fish more than just fishing?
Because it is a fight to prove himself after 84 days without a catch. It is a test of his patience, courage and dignity, and a struggle between man and nature, not simply a way to earn a living. He even respects the fish and calls it his brother.
4What lesson can readers learn from Santiago's endurance?
That a person may be destroyed but never defeated. Patience, hope and determination matter more than the result, and we should never give up no matter how hard the struggle is.
Write a formal email of (120-150) words
"To your teacher apologizing for not attending the school day and telling her/him the reason."
✍️Model answer نموذج إجابة
From: youssef2026@yahoo.com
To: mr.ahmed@school.edu.eg
Subject: Apology for my absence on Sunday

Dear Mr. Ahmed,

I hope this message finds you well. I am writing to apologize for not attending school last Sunday. Unfortunately, I woke up with a high temperature and a severe sore throat, and the doctor advised me to stay in bed and rest for the whole day. A medical report is attached to this email.

I am sorry for missing your lesson, and I understand how important it was. I have already borrowed my classmate's notes and I have studied the new lesson at home. If there is any extra work or an assignment I should complete, I would be grateful if you could let me know.

Thank you for your time and consideration.

Yours sincerely,
Youssef Osman
